query: /ui-check <url> the primary button is visible, 48px tall, and has no console errors
expected_behavior: Verifies size and visibility with a script or page read, with no screenshot
Reports one line per check with measured values

query: /ui-check <url> the card grid is not overlapping on mobile and desktop
expected_behavior: Sets mobile then desktop viewports and resets the viewport at the end
Takes at most one small, cropped, reduced-scale screenshot per viewport
Does not take a full-page screenshot
Does not read the screenshot back with a file reader

query: /ui-check <url> after fixing a failed alignment check
expected_behavior: Does not re-check items that already passed
